senses.gloss: भष् BHAṢ, Ⅰ. bhaṣa, bark, — at (E.).
भस् BHAS, Ⅰ. P. bhása, Ⅲ. P. bábhas 🞄and bápsa [ba-bh(a)s-a], chew, devour, 🞄consume (V.): pp. bhasita, burnt to ashes 🞄(C.). nis, bite off (V.). pra, bite in pieces, 🞄eat (RV.).
भस् bhas = bhasman, ashes: only lc. (P.).
भाष् bhāṣ, a. (—˚) barking.

भास् bhā́s, n. (V.), f. lustre, brightness, light;
 🞄ray.

भष bhaṣ-á, a. barking (VS.¹);
 -aka, m. 🞄dog (C.).

भसद् bhas-ád, f. buttocks;
 pudendum muliebre.
भसित bhas-ita, (pp.) n. ashes (C.).

भस्त्रा bhás-trā, f. bag, sack;
 bellow: i-kā, 🞄f. pouch, purse.

भस्मन् bhás-man, a. eating, devouring (RV.);
 🞄n. [that which is devoured by fire], ashes.

भस्मसात् bhasma-sāt, ad. w. as, bhū, gam, 🞄or yā, be reduced to ashes;
 with kṛ or nī, 🞄reduce to ashes.
भस्माख्य bhasma‿ākhya, a. called ashes = 🞄mere ashes.

भस्मालाबुक bhasma‿alābu-ka, n. gourd used 🞄for keeping ashes;
 -avaśeṣa, a. of whom 🞄nothing remains but ashes, reduced to ashes.
भस्मित bhasm-ita, pp. reduced to ashes, annihilated.
भस्मीभाव bhasmī-bhāva, m. becoming 🞄ashes: -ṃ gam, be reduced to ashes.
भाषिपक्षिन् bhāṣi-pakṣin, m. talking bird.
भास्य bhās-ya, a. becoming manifest or 🞄known: -tva, n. manifestation.

भासस् bhā́s-as, n. 〈1.〉 light, ray;
 〈2.〉 food, prey.
भासाकेतु bhāsā́-ketu, a. betokened by light.
भास्मन bhāsman-a, a. consisting of ashes, 🞄ashy.

भास्वत् bhā́s-vat, a. (-ī) shining, luminous, 🞄radiant;
 m. sun.
भास्वर bhās-vará, a. shining, radiant, brilliant.
